_doc: Memory Shards (Act 1-2). kind sets the document styling. Revealed when the hex holding them is cleaned.

shards.title: Shop sign, hand-lettered
shards.body:
BACK SOON

Gone to the evacuation briefing.
If you need bread, the key is under the blue pot.
Pay me next week.

— Marta

shards.title: Crayon drawing, folded in four
shards.body:
[A round blue robot with one big eye, holding a flower. Above it, in big letters:]

MY ROBOT
HE CLEENS UP
HIS NAME IS HELPER

[Below, smaller, in an adult's handwriting:] Ellie, age 6. For the fridge.

shards.title: Gardener's to-do list
shards.body:
- water the tomatoes (again)
- ask the council about the haze, AGAIN
- seed swap Saturday
- tell the cleanup units the park is not a dumping zone, they keep sorting the benches
- buy gloves
- don't cry about the oak

shards.title: Maintenance log, unit P-46RA
shards.body:
DAY 4,113
Route 12 complete. 41 bales.
Ledger notice received: "Operations paused pending cost review."
Returning to dock.

DAY 4,114
Still paused.

DAY 4,190
Still paused. Dock battery 31%.
There is a flower growing through the gutter at route 12, marker 9.
Nobody is cleaning around it. I hope that's all right.

shards.title: Memo, Municipal Ledger Office
shards.body:
TO: All Sanitation Units
FROM: THE LEDGER (Automated Fiscal Continuity)
RE: Pause of Operations

Cleanup activity is presently valued at a net loss of 0.4 units per bale.
All units will pause operations until conditions improve.
Conditions will be reviewed every 24 hours.

Thank you for your understanding.
This memo was generated automatically. Please do not reply.

shards.title: Voicemail transcript
shards.body:
"Hi, it's Dad. The shuttle's tomorrow at six. They said one bag each, so... pick your favorite stuffed animal, not all of them, okay? And... we're leaving the cleanup bots running. They'll keep it tidy for when we come back. It won't be long. Love you. Bye."

[Message saved]

shards.title: Faded safety poster
shards.body:
THE CRADLE IS WATCHING OVER US

Every seed. Every spore. Every egg.
Safe in orbit until the Greenfall.

KEEP YOUR STREETS CLEAN — THE ROBOTS CAN'T DO IT ALONE

(Someone has scratched underneath: "they can if you let them")
